purpose: Retrain and evaluate a defensible PPO baseline for the AEMO Decision Transformer paper. The shipped PPO reference is a 204,800-step unseeded default-configuration checkpoint; the manuscript describes a tuned 4M-step Optuna search.

protocol.env_construction: one env per (region x battery variant); regions are NOT concatenated, unlike retrain_sb3_full_fcas.py which interleaves all 5 regions row-by-row after sorting by SETTLEMENTDATE.

statistics_summary.method: 10,000-resample percentile bootstrap of the paired DT-PPO difference; paired Wilcoxon signed-rank; cell-level CI as in paper/audit/reproduce_significance.py, plus region-cluster and scenario-block cluster bootstrap sensitivities.

expanded_broad_2024.dt_cells_source: shipped surface; 2-scenario spot check reproduced exactly
